Key Points for Patients Prior to Bariatric Surgery
•• Reduce intake of high-fat foods.
•• Use meal replacement shakes for breakfast.
•• Pack lunch instead of eating fast food.
•• Reduce intake of sweets.
•• Snack on fresh fruit.
•• Substitute one half serving of a meal replacement shake instead of an evening snack.
•• Take prescribed dietary supplements as directed by the pre-op nutritional and lab tests 
evaluations.

Post-Operative Nutrition Therapy
Post-operative recommendations for dietary advancement are outlined in Table 7-9. 
Although there are no strict dietary guidelines after bariatric surgery, the recommen-

of food consistency over weeks or months.100,101 Patients are typically advised to
